description.value:
Can be used to conceal one non-concealable weapon. Does not count for carry amount. Adds 4 SP to armor. Can be removed with an action. If destroyed loses all benefits but the penalty is also removed. -2 to REF/DEX/MOVE (apply the SP and penalty at the table). If being searched for some reason, the weapon will be immediately discovered along with any armor you might be wearing underneath.

Cost: Tech Upgrade

Item Compendium (2070) • Armor & Shields
